description: Inkling 2 Small (thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Small, 594B total and 17B active mixture of experts, Apache-2.0) on two DGX Sparks through TensorFold's Zig engine (tensorfold-native) as ajensenwaud's InkSpark kit 1c15d646 builds and runs it: TensorFold v1.2.7 (93a2e93e) plus the kit's 46 patches (patches-zig/: the inkling2 CUDA family with two-rank tensor parallelism over NCCL and RoCE writes, EXL3 experts, the checkpoint's own DSpark drafter, the vision tower, fp8 KV for the global layers, the Inkling reply, reasoning and tool-call parser), compiled for sm_121 on the kit's base image (Mia AI Lab's GLM-5.3 TensorFold image: NVIDIA PyTorch 26.07, CUDA 13.3, NCCL 2.30.7) with Zig 0.17.0 and the libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1 and libwebp 1.6.0 decoders. The creator publishes no image, so this recipe builds the kit's own build. Weights: ajensenwaud/inkspark-2dgx aa29f3a0, an EXL3 quantization at about 2.2 bits per weight (experts 2.17 bpw, attention 6, head 8; drafter and vision tower bf16), 170.5 GB, about 84 GiB per Spark. Settings are the kit's default shape (SHAPE=long): one stream at a 1,048,576-token window, image input on, drafter on with nvfp4 draft projections, fp8 KV for the global layers (lossy; bf16 is the kit's alternative), a 3 GiB memory reserve per rank, replies of up to 4,096 tokens without max_tokens (the engine's default). The kit's eight-stream 131,072-token shape (SHAPE=agents) is not offered here. Thinking is the model's: every request carries an effort level (reasoning_effort none to max, default high), and the model may still think briefly at none. tool_choice auto only: the kit builds no grammar library, so required or named tool choices and structured output are refused. Memory: the declared per-rank peak is 123,378,774,528 bytes, the engine's own budget bound (the idle-available floor of 126,600,000,000 bytes less the 3 GiB reserve the kit sets): the engine sizes its window states and prompt cache from the memory free at start, so a rank may use everything but the reserve. The kit refuses to start a rank with less than 100 GiB available. This is an estimate until the hardware try measures it; nothing else should share the two Sparks. Licences (information only): the checkpoint is Apache-2.0 under Thinking Machines' terms; the kit is BSD-3-Clause and its TensorFold patches Apache-2.0; TensorFold is Apache-2.0; the image carries NVIDIA's container terms and the libjpeg-turbo and libwebp licences.
title: Inkling 2 Small InkSpark EXL3 2.17bpw TensorFold two Sparks (ajensenwaud)
